Name: Pink Cat Ears
Author: OfInstrumentals
Description:
What it says on the tin. You can choose from no whiskers (default), pink whiskers, or the vanilla brown whiskers. They can be changed either with the config file or with Generic Mod Config Menu.
You can also choose whether they are also pink on pets, or just the vanilla brown. The default is pink.

There is now a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33968]Fashion Sense version[/url]﻿ of this mod. It doesn't iclude the options for pets, or the whiskers though.

[b]Requires [/b]SMAPI and Content Patcher

[b]Install[/b] by unzipping and moving the [i]Pink Cat Ears[/i] folder in to Stardew Valley/Mods
If you've downloaded this mod previously, you may have a version with a folder that has a bunch of numbers in the name. I recommend deleting that old folder before moving the new one in to the Mods-folder.

Downloads.Description: Updated for 1.6. Now also available for pets.
